en.Empfänger, Betreff und Wortlaut festlege: Set recipient, subject, and wording, and select the waiting status.
en.Entwurf, nicht versendet: Die Rückfrage: Draft, not sent: The follow-up question is only sent when you send it yourself. The item is now waiting for customer or internal.
en.Fachliche Beurteilung festhalten und dar: Record the technical assessment and document a decision based on it.
en.Firma, Kundennummer oder Ansprechpartner: Company, customer number or contact person …

en.Grund, Typ, Priorität, Auswirkung und Zu: Set reason, type, priority, impact, and responsibility.
en.Halte fest, was geantwortet wurde und wi: Record what was answered and how complete the response is.

en.Nichts Dringendes — die Klärung läuft pl: Nothing urgent — clarification is on schedule.

en.Offene Fragen zu dieser Anforderung erfa: Record open questions about this requirement as an open item.

en.Optional: Auf welche Informationsquelle: Optional: Which information source does the follow-up question refer to?
en.Optional: Aus dem Punkt eine verantworte: Optional: Turn the item into an assigned task. No task is created without a title.
en.Optional: E-Mail, Zeichnung oder Notiz z: Optional: record an email, drawing or note for the inquiry.
en.Optional: Entscheidung auf Basis der Beu: Optional: document a decision based on the assessment — without automatic approval.

en.Schließe den Punkt mit Ergebnis ab oder: Close the item with a result or have the response reviewed again.
en.Was möchte der Kunde und wie ist die Anf: What does the customer want and how was the inquiry received?
en.Was wird gefordert, woher stammt es und: What is required, where does it come from, and what target value applies?
en.Welche Anforderungen und Quellen sind be: Which requirements and sources are affected? Both are optional.
en.Welche Anforderungen und offenen Punkte: Which requirements and open items does this concern? Multiple selection possible.
en.Wie dringend ist die Anfrage und wer küm: How urgent is the inquiry and who is handling it?
en.Wird mit angelegt (Status wird vom Syste: Will be created as well (status is assigned by the system)
en.Worauf wartet der Punkt, bis die Antwort: What is the item waiting for until the answer arrives?

en.Zu welcher Anfrage gehört die Anforderun: Which inquiry does the requirement belong to?
en.Zu welcher Kundenanfrage gehört der offe: Which customer request does the open item belong to?
en.Zu welcher Kundenanfrage gehört die Beur: Which customer request does the assessment belong to?
en.Zu welcher Kundenanfrage gehört die Rück: Which customer request does the follow-up question belong to?
en.Zum Abschluss eines offenen Punkts muss: To close an open item, the response must be reviewed and the result entered.
en.Zum Abschluss muss zuerst das Ergebnis d: To close, the result must first be documented — please enter it in the details.
